narrative: Paris Saint-Germain lead the race for the title on 61%, still clear of RC Lens on 13%.

Paris Saint-Germain's title chance fell 12 points to 61%, the largest move of the week; Marseille up 8, RC Strasbourg down 5, Olympique Lyonnais up 5 followed, measured against the forecast of 2026-08-19.
At the other end, Angers SCO are the most likely to go down at 57%.
